answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the glacier of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dawn of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
